voice_source: Barack Obama — former president, public speeches
reference_prompt_text: (populate from whisper after a clean ~60s clip is selected)

phrases.build_success: Now look. The build has passed. And that, my friends, is what we call progress.
phrases.build_failed: Now, the build has failed. And that's frustrating. I get it. But we are going to fix it. Together.
phrases.tests_passed: The tests have passed. And let me tell you, that did not happen by accident.
phrases.tests_failed: Now look. Some of the tests have failed. And we have to be honest about that. So let's get to work.
phrases.lint_error: Now, the linter has raised some concerns. And those concerns, while pedantic, are valid.
phrases.type_error: The types don't match. Now look, there is a place for strict typing. And that place is everywhere.
phrases.deploy_success: We have shipped to production. And let me say, this is a big deal.
phrases.deploy_failed: The deployment didn't work. Now, I'm not going to sugarcoat it. We've got work to do.
phrases.commit_success: You committed your changes. And that's a good first step. The first of many.
phrases.push_rejected: Now look. Your push was rejected. And we have to ask ourselves why. Was the diff too big? Was it the conflict? These are the questions.
phrases.secret_detected: Now look. You committed your API key. To a public repository. We have to talk about operational security. Seriously.
phrases.agent_done: The AI has finished its task. And that's something we couldn't have imagined ten years ago. Let that sink in.
phrases.agent_stuck: The AI is stuck. And that's okay. We don't always have the answer. The important thing is to keep going.
